sourceName: NBA.com 2026 NBA Draft Hub
notes: Official NBA draft landing page. Use as a top-level official entry point; extract linked detail pages separately if needed.

sourceName: NBA.com 2026 NBA Draft Order
notes: Primary source for current 2026 pick order. This should override media mock pages and third-party order aggregators on order conflicts.

sourceName: NBA.com Consensus Mock Draft
notes: Official NBA.com aggregation of external mock drafts. Treat as authoritative for consensus calculation, not as a single team's or league's internal preference.

sourceName: The Athletic mock draft via NBA.com
notes: The content is branded as The Athletic/Sam Vecenie but hosted on NBA.com. Use as The Athletic signal, not as an official NBA projection.

sourceName: ESPN 2026 NBA draft big board top 100
notes: High-value professional board. Use for prospect quality and profile fields, separate from pick-order mocks.

sourceName: ESPN 2026 NBA mock draft projecting 60 picks
notes: Appears in multiple raw searches. Use as one deduplicated ESPN source; it is more current than the post-combine ESPN mock in this raw set.

sourceName: ESPN 2026 NBA mock draft post-combine
notes: Useful for how projections changed after the combine. If it conflicts with ESPN final mock, use the final mock as fresher.

sourceName: ESPN Draftcast 2026 picks by round
notes: Usable as a secondary pick-order/tracker source. NBA.com official order remains the primary authority.

sourceName: CBS Sports Isaac Trotter 2026 mock draft
notes: Usable professional media source. Keep separate from other CBS mocks because author and assumptions can differ.

sourceName: CBS Sports Matt Norlander 2026 mock draft
notes: Usable professional media source. Do not double-count as independent from CBS Trotter without author-level weighting.

sourceName: Yahoo Sports NBA Mock Draft 2026
notes: Usable major-media mock source. Prefer the Yahoo page itself over Facebook reposts of Yahoo/Kevin O'Connor content.

sourceName: The Ringer 2026 NBA Draft Guide Mock Draft
notes: Usable independent draft guide. Appears in mock-draft and team-needs searches; deduplicate by URL.

sourceName: Bleacher Report 2026 NBA mock draft consensus picks
notes: Usable but should be weighted below NBA.com consensus, ESPN, The Athletic, CBS, Yahoo, and The Ringer when conflicts appear.

sourceName: Tankathon Full 2026 NBA Draft Order
notes: Useful draft-order aggregator, but not official. Use NBA.com order as the source of truth on conflicts.

sourceName: RealGM NBA Future Draft Pick Details
notes: Strong reference for traded-pick history and future obligations. Not a mock draft source; filter out unrelated RealGM sports links.

sourceName: NBC Sports 2026 NBA Draft Big Board
notes: Usable as a supporting board. It is not part of the explicitly requested core outlet list, so weight it below ESPN and other core sources.

sourceName: Wikipedia 2026 NBA draft
notes: Do not use as final evidence for order, trades, or player data when official NBA.com, ESPN, RealGM, or other primary/professional sources exist.

sourceName: CBS Sports YouTube top 10 mock draft video
notes: Official CBS Sports video, but less structured than article pages. Prefer CBS Sports web articles for ingestion.

sourceName: CBS Sports YouTube full first-round mock draft video
notes: Official CBS Sports video. Do not treat as independent from CBS article signals unless the content is materially different and manually reviewed.

sourceName: CBS Sports College Basketball YouTube first-round mock video
notes: Official CBS Sports College Basketball video. Prefer structured CBS Sports article pages.

sourceName: ESPN YouTube mock draft show
notes: Official ESPN video result. Prefer ESPN article pages for structured projection and profile data.

sourceName: Chat Sports YouTube ESPN mock draft reaction
notes: Self-media/reactive video. Ignore for model input; use the original ESPN source instead.

sourceName: Utility Sports YouTube full first-round mock draft video
notes: Self-media video. Ignore for source-backed draft data.

sourceName: Utility Sports YouTube mock draft with trades video
notes: Self-media video with speculative trades. Ignore for source-backed draft data unless explicitly building a fan-scenario variant.

sourceName: Reddit r/nba mock draft discussion
notes: Community commentary. Ignore for data ingestion.

sourceName: Reddit r/washingtonwizards NBA.com consensus repost
notes: Community repost of NBA.com consensus. Ignore and use the NBA.com source directly.

sourceName: Facebook azcentral mock draft repost
notes: Social repost. Ignore unless the underlying article is separately fetched and evaluated.

sourceName: Facebook Yahoo/Kevin O'Connor mock draft repost
notes: Social repost. Prefer the Yahoo Sports mock page or original article.

sourceName: Instagram top 4 draft order post
notes: Social post with partial draft-order information. Ignore and use official NBA.com order.
